#### Biomass {.tabset .tabset-dropdown}

In the experiment we studied two-patch meta-ecosystems in which we manipulated the size of their patches and their connection (unconnected vs connected). Now, we want to know whether meta-ecosystem size influenced the effects of connection on this response variable. Therefore, we start by looking at how this response variable changed across time for all meta-ecosystems through its mean ± 95 confidence interval:

```{r fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output}
ggarrange(plot.metaecos.points(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(size_effects == "fixed"),
                               response_variable)  +
            rremove("xlab") +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis),
          NULL,
          plot.metaecos.points(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(size_effects == "relative"),
                               response_variable)  +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("xlab", size = size_y_axis) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(ds_metaecosystems$day)) +
            theme(legend.position = "none"),
          heights = c(1, 0.1, 0.8),
          nrow = 3,
          align = "v",
          labels = c(fixed_label, "", relative_label),
          label.x = c(0.03, 0, -0.055),
          label.y = c(0.745, 0, 1.06))
```
